title: Blender import fails when light colours are expressed in Kelvin
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1] - Blender Version 4.5.2 LTS - OS Windows 11 ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Intel(R) Arc(TM) Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.6314) - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 5 125H (18 threads) - 15.37 GiB memory ### Issue description When importing a Blender scene where there is a Point Light with a Temperature expressed in Kelvin, importing the Blender scene fails with the following stack trace. Remove the temperature in Kelvin fixes the import. ``` ERROR: Blender exportation failed: faultCode 1 faultString :Error: Python: Traceback (most recent call last): ERROR: File "C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\addons_core\io_scene_gltf2\__init__.py", line 1370, in execute ERROR: res = gltf2_blender_export.save(context, export_settings) ERROR: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ ERROR: File "C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\addons_core\io_scene_gltf2\blender\exp\export.py", line 37, in save ERROR: json, buffer = __export(export_settings) ERROR: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ ERROR: File "C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\addons_core\io_scene_gltf2\blender\exp\export.py", line 55, in __export ERROR: __gather_gltf(exporter, export_settings) ERROR: File "C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\addons_core\io_scene_gltf2\blender\exp\export.py", line 210, in __gather_gltf ERROR: active_scene_idx, scenes, animations = gltf2_blender_gather.gather_gltf2(export_settings) ERROR: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ ERROR: File "C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\addons_core\io_scene_gltf2\blender\exp\gather.py", line 44, in gather_gltf2 ERROR: scenes.append(__gather_scene(blender_scene, export_settings)) ERROR: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ ERROR: File "C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\addons_core\io_scene_gltf2\blender\exp\cache.py", line 37, in wrapper_cached ERROR: result = func(*args, **kwargs) ERROR: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ ERROR: File "C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\addons_core\io_scene_gltf2\blender\exp\gather.py", line 109, in __gather_scene ERROR: node = gltf2_blender_gather_nodes.gather_node( ERROR: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ ERROR: File "C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\addons_core\io_scene_gltf2\blender\exp\nodes.py", line 56, in gather_node ERROR: extensions=__gather_extensions(vnode, export_settings), ERROR: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ ERROR: File "C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\addons_core\io_scene_gltf2\blender\exp\nodes.py", line 215, in __gather_extensions ERROR: light = gltf2_blender_gather_lights.gather_lights_punctual( ERROR: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ ERROR: File "C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\addons_core\io_scene_gltf2\blender\exp\cache.py", line 37, in wrapper_cached ERROR: result = func(*args, **kwargs) ERROR: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ ERROR: File "C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\addons_core\io_scene_gltf2\blender\exp\lights.py", line 27, in gather_lights_punctual ERROR: color=__gather_color(blender_lamp, export_settings), ERROR: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ ERROR: File "C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\addons_core\io_scene_gltf2\blender\exp\lights.py", line 71, in __gather_color ERROR: color[0] *= temperature_color ERROR: ~~~~~^^^ ERROR: TypeError: color[item] = x: assigned value not a number ERROR: Location: C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.5\4.5\scripts\modules\bpy\ops.py:109 ERROR: Error importing 'res://Assets/Concept.blend'. ``` ### Steps to reproduce Import a .blend file with point lights with temperatures expressed in Kelvin. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
